findings.label: Gallery ordering on server timestamp
findings.detail: streamMyPhotos() uses orderBy('createdAt', descending: true) while createdAt is written as FieldValue.serverTimestamp(), so a just-uploaded doc carries a null createdAt locally until the server resolves it and can be briefly omitted from the ordered result. Self-correcting on the next snapshot; optionally order by a client-set field or tolerate the latency.

findings.label: No static analysis run
findings.detail: flutter analyze / flutter pub get were never executed because no Dart/Flutter SDK exists in the build environment. Documented in verification.md and SETUP.md; the user must run them after `flutter create .`. Accepted by the task constraints, not a code defect.
